title: Kyle sends whole sensory experiences telepathically

tellings.quote: sends that message to you telepathically you receive the smells and the feelings

plain: A filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about children she says can read minds, tells a story about a young man in England named Kyle, passing on what Kyle and his mother told her. According to Dickens, when Kyle sends a message by telepathy, meaning mind to mind with no words or signs, the person receiving it also gets the smells and feelings that go with it. If true, it would mean thought can carry whole experiences from one person to another, not just words.
